sup:70410.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,
We acknowledge receipt of your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
Please note:
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We acknowledge your increased volume of 23,400 pieces and the 24-month contract, which allows us to adjust our price to €31.70 per unit.
A lead time of 56 days is strictly required to maintain our production standards.
Our colleagues will address your inquiry regarding the cost breakdown.
Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message, which we have processed.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For the record:
We verified the historical purchase orders you cited; the data holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We must maintain the 56-day lead time, as it is strictly required for our production standards.
Building on your commitment to 23,400 pieces over 24 months, we adjust our price to €31.60 per unit.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
These are our standard conditions for this product.
Please address any further questions in writing to this office.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
